sourceBackingDiagnostic.scope: Physical owned WebView GC-capable heap source backing stores only; not PSS acceptance
sourceBackingDiagnostic.method: Read each system / Script internal source edge, then its two native system / ExternalStringData backing_store edges; sum the shallow self sizes of four distinct native nodes backing two retained source strings per capture. Each source string node has unchanged 56-byte self size. V8 heap snapshot may collect garbage; diagnostic is separate from PSS run.
limitations: Only two selected retained script source backings, not total JS heap, allocation rate, retained app memory or PSS.
Main script remains reachable through live functions; ASCII escaping changes source representation, not translated runtime strings.
Unchanged public boot-guard.js still contains literal non-ASCII; not every shipped JavaScript file is ASCII.
Before/after are distinct APKs and captures; no causal whole-app memory saving is established.
